g.text: In adults on lipid-lowering therapy (particularly with ASCVD, CKM syndrome, type 2 diabetes

text.style: font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #202124

g.text: or elevated TG), “measurement of apoB is reasonable to guide decisions regarding further

text.style: font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #202124

g.text: therapeutic intensification” — once LDL-C and/or non-HDL-C goals have been achieved.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #202124
font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #202124
font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #202124

g.text: “In adults not on LLT, measurement of apoB may be reasonable to enhance ASCVD risk

text.style: font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #202124
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff

font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #202124
font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #202124

g.text: In adults with TG ≥ 150 mg/dL, “measurement of non–HDL-C or apoB is preferred over LDL-C.”

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff

font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #202124

g.text: “In all adults, measurement of Lp(a) concentration is recommended at least once for

font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #202124

g.text: Adults aged 30–59 at low (< 3%) 10-year risk, with LDL-C < 160 mg/dL and 30-year risk

text.style: font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #202124

g.text: < 10%: counselling on health behaviours is recommended.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #202124
font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #202124
font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #202124

g.text: Same group with LDL-C 160–189 mg/dL or 30-year risk ≥ 10%: a moderate-intensity statin is

text.style: font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #202124

g.text: reasonable, to reduce cumulative exposure to atherogenic lipoproteins.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #626a73

g.text: COR: 1 = is recommended · 2a = is reasonable · 2b = may be reasonable. LOE: A = high-quality RCTs · B-NR = non-randomized · C-LD = limited data.
